decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese wheel close to the established offer, it likely fits existing production and distribution with low carrying costs, so the option remains worth keeping while its market position is still not fully certain.

The spicy cheese line with several models has higher complexity and carrying costs, but it builds on established capabilities and may still hold option value if demand for spiced cheeses develops, so the firm is likely to keep it.

Mild creamy soft cheese is more perishable and niche, which raises carrying costs, but it is still close to the firm's dairy base and the firm holds few other new-product options, so it is likely kept unless results clearly weaken.
